title: Abuja National Mosque
visualBrief: Individual Abuja National Mosque exterior: mapped stepped square envelope with inward-battered warm stone facades,narrow dark recesses,an upper cross-shaped mass,broad golden central dome and small roof cupolas,four slender cream minarets with flared collars and pointed caps,a recessed-looking west entrance with brass doors and original coarse colored panels,and a low cusped parapet. The separate grounds buildings,boundary walls,landscaping,street,interiors,historic artwork,inscriptions and engineering are excluded.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained Q1430127 had only reference point[7.4925,9.060833333],no physical footprint and no dimensions. Current ordinary PMTiles supplies two Abuja National Mosque POIs;one shares the24-vertex main building id35184560926061. That named footprint and ten associated roof/minaret parts establish the current physical site,about305 m west of the old reference. The current named point fixes the model anchor;the old reference is retained verbatim. Cardinal axes and the west entrance are approximate visualization choices from map shape and inspected pictures.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Current upper part retains min_height25/height30 m;roof retains min_height30/height40 m;four tower bases retain height6 m;two column parts retain height55 m and two have no height. The source uses the upper part25–30 m as a roof-zone envelope,roof top40 m and overall tower tips55 m above the local floor;the other two tower tips infer the same55 m. The upper drum/terrace subdivisions are estimates within the mapped roof-zone envelope.
